title: The Second Chance at the Recipe
youtube_title: The Second Chance at the Recipe | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who helped, and helping back, keeps a home kind.
summary: At a bedroom with the hall light still on, Greta notices that Grandma Nia has already taken care of a second chance at a recipe without a sigh. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Greta does one useful thing Grandma Nia did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
